## WIP Report PDF → Gmail (weekly)

Runs **weekly** (Friday 18:00 UK). Reads **Operative Job Sheet** + **OJS BOQ & SMV**.

**Weekly filter:** all **open jobs** (WIP / jeopardy / OJS scope complete) **plus** jobs **completed in the past 7 days** (Europe/London). All visit rows for matched jobs are included so jeopardy/status stay accurate.

POSTs to `/generate-job-report-pdf`. Requires **Job Status Check** to have run first.

**Redeploy `job_report.py` on the API server** after backend changes.
